title: The Small Letters
author: Rosalind Almeida
blurb: Paloma Villalobos, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
